cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for this local video edit, providing the original camera framing, visible action sequence, pacing and duration.
<Subject 1> is the woman with long dark hair wearing a white suit in <Video 1>. Her face, hair, clothing, position and hand gestures are retained.
<Subject 2> is the original wood-paneled room in <Video 1>, including the pale carved fireplace and mantel directly behind the woman. The fireplace and its projecting carved surround are the region to remove.
Source context: A woman in a white suit is standing in front of an ornate fireplace, gesturing with her hands as if she is explaining something.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. The woman continues the original gestures in the same room, with the ornate fireplace removed.
Requested edit: Remove the ornate fireplace

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the woman's identity, hair, white suit, body position, expressions and complete hand-gesture sequence, including their original timing.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - remove the entire ornate fireplace, its pale carved mantel shelf and carved supporting surround behind the woman. Fill that local region with a continuous plain wall consistent with the surrounding room's color, perspective and lighting. Retain the rest of the original room and its composition.
<Video 1> (cut and pacing structure): fully_preserved - preserve the original camera framing and movement, shot continuity, action order, timing and duration.

detailed_description:
The target video retains the photographic appearance, warm indoor lighting and camera composition of <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] The same woman in a white suit stands in the same place, moving her hands and speaking with the same expressions as in <Video 1>. Behind her is a continuous plain section of the original room's wall where the ornate fireplace used to be. The carved fireplace, projecting mantel shelf and supporting columns are absent throughout the shot. Her foreground silhouette and gestures remain clear against the repaired background.
The complete visible action sequence and all its phases follow <Video 1> in their original order and timing.

cases.evaluation_scope: official short source subset; basic task repair

router.query_support: all spatial queries in each position bin overlapping valid physical time; pure-pad bins remain native

purpose: Finish the unsubmitted original fireplace repair with unchanged P1 and sampling; new independent process, preserve R100 timeout and results.
condition_scope: Six actual Qwen/tag/reference/position clean condition blobs, AV noise and all20x0+final archives per run; same-source paired actual equality. No reference audio input.
source_event_annotations: Evaluation-only source observations. No hand-marked action window enters model or router.
cost: Record20NFE/20callbacks/1000blocks; Native0/ON450 routed blocks; capture time separate; no online observer.

evaluation.official: No full official benchmark score is claimed; future inherited metric use must be labelled clip exploration.
evaluation.adaptation: Complete official short sources; original frame/PTS map retained, padding excluded; source-specific basic edit acceptance precedes any guide.
evaluation.visibility_policy: 0114 ball/player interactions;0392 hand gestures with local background removal. Preserve failures and skips.

acceleration_axes.weights: Same four checkpoint SHAs and nine core SHAs as prior H3 experiments
acceleration_axes.runtime: Host9 R87 runtime/core and six numerical kernels; normal memory,reserve8,disable dynamic VRAM.
acceleration_axes.attention: Native PyTorch SDPA via inherited audited block wrapper; H3 Sage patch absent
acceleration_axes.linear_backend: Triton INT8 with inherited row chunking guard
acceleration_axes.sampler: Euler20 manual shifted video sigmas12/audio3, CFG1
acceleration_axes.cache: Same-source Native/forced share actual .9 conditions and raw AV noise; two independent caches.
acceleration_axes.postprocessing: Original R91 0114 input107/105 and R64 0392 input73/57 reused exact; crop16,8,1280,720@24; no speed change.
acceleration_axes.snapshot_cost: 20 intermediate AV snapshots plus final per job; measure separately

first_pair: No forced first source: first source selected GUIDE is reviewed after its actual pair; all sources may be Native-only.

screening.resume: No automatic resubmission or restart after release; preserve pending review.
